nameOrigin: a type of rock; Onix is Steelix’s prevolution

pokedexEntries.go: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

pokedexEntries.si: It is said that if an ONIX lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

pokedexEntries.cr: The many small metal particles that cover this POKéMON’s body reflect bright light well.

pokedexEntries.rs: STEELIX lives even further underground than ONIX. This POKéMON is known to dig towards the earth’s core. There are records of this POKéMON reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.

pokedexEntries.di: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

pokedexEntries.prl: It chews its way through boulders with its sturdy jaws. Its eyes can see in the darkness underground.

pokedexEntries.pt: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.
